source: interface NativeView<T> { value: { [K in keyof T as `pre_${K & string}`]: T[K] } } type Native = NativeView<Record<string, number>>; type Pattern = { value: { [K: `pre_${string}`]: number } }; type Wrong = { value: { [K: `pre_${string}`]: string } }; interface Read<T, K extends keyof T> { value: T[K] } type Overlap = { [K: string]: unknown; [K: `pre_${string}`]: { a: number }; [K: `${string}_end`]: { b: string } }; type NativeRead = Read<Overlap, "pre_a_end">; type PlainRead = { value: { a: number; b: string } };
